Black smokers: underwater chimneys of gold and copper with +400 °C water that never boils. 😱
Adding to the 1977 hydrothermal vent discovery mentioned at 10:20: while the biology of these sunless ecosystems revolutionized science, their physical chemistry is just as astonishing. Along tectonic seafloor rifts, hydrothermal fluids get superheated by subsurface magma to a blistering +400 °C. The water remains in a dense liquid state without boiling solely because the surrounding ocean exerts a crushing pressure of 200 to 300 atmospheres. The instant this mineral-saturated fluid vents into near-freezing 2 °C abyssal water, dissolved transition metals precipitate out on the spot. Over centuries, this reaction builds towering 30-meter-tall mineral chimneys composed of rich copper, zinc, silver, and gold sulfides.
